# Daniel Boles

> Applied AI developer and technical project manager. Daniel Boles builds LLM systems, agent governance, evaluation and language technology, and publishes the code with its test results.

- Sole developer of a private production AI editing and translation suite: 59 Python packages and more than 10,000 automated tests. The suite stays private because it is company work; the public repositories below show the same method.
- 40 of 41 translations passed automated QA with a local Qwen model, against 33 of 41 for retrieval alone.
- An audit of an earlier review found 9 of 14 citation identifiers wrong.
- Method: each project starts with a question and a written design; coding agents implement it under test suites and review gates; every change faces tests or an evaluation; failures are recorded with their numbers.
- Contact: daniel@danboles.me

## Agents and LLM systems

- [agent-gateway](https://github.com/dboles99/agent-gateway): admission control, budgets, checkpoints and watchdogs for coding agents that run unattended. 241 tests passed, 1 skipped.
- [tm-rag-copilot](https://dboles99.github.io/tm-rag-copilot/): retrieval over a synthetic translation memory with deterministic QA. The right match is in the top 10 for 82.9% of queries with a language filter.
- [docx-mcp](https://github.com/dboles99/docx-mcp): a read-only MCP server that lets an agent read a Word document as it would stand with every tracked change accepted. 67 tests passed; six tools, none of which can write.
- [rosetta-bench](https://github.com/dboles99/rosetta-bench) and [rosetta](https://github.com/dboles99/rosetta): a harness for comparing prompt formats across model providers, and tooling that keeps one prompt in a human form and a machine form. 38 and 50 tests passed.

## Research (manuscripts, not submitted or peer-reviewed)

- [Pseudocode as a guardrail](https://github.com/dboles99/pseudocode-ai-workflows): a language model drafts a pseudocode specification, a compiler enforces its contracts, and execution finds what review missed. Eight defects found by execution.
- [Detecting LLM text watermarks](https://github.com/dboles99/llm-watermark-lab): a research lab and evidence synthesis on what statistical watermarks can and cannot show. It ships no tooling for removing watermarks.
- [Papers](https://github.com/dboles99/papers)

## Software

- [BachelorPad+ Lite](https://github.com/dboles99/bachelorpluslite): a Rust text editor with Notepad's features and a local note layer that never touches the network. 1,104 test functions.
- [BachelorPad+](https://github.com/dboles99/bachelorpadplus_rust): the larger Rust text-processing application for Windows and Linux. 2,026 test functions.
- [SlideBridge](https://github.com/dboles99/SlideBridge): converts PowerPoint decks into review-ready Word documents with slide images and tables. 45 tests passed.
- [Amplified Futures](https://github.com/dboles99/amplified-futures-vcv): C++ DSP modules for VCV Rack 2, built for drone, feedback and detuned oscillator systems.
